Digital India BHASHINI: Building the Future of Language AI

Syllabus Areas:

GS II - Governance

GS III - Science and Technology , Artificial Intelligence

The Digital India BHASHINI Division (DIBD), under the Digital India Corporation (DIC), Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY), Government of India, organised “BHASHINI शिल्पी” at the Embassy of India, Kathmandu, Nepal, on 31 August 2026.

The session brought together developers, technology practitioners and innovators from Nepal to explore how Language AI can be used to develop inclusive and multilingual digital solutions.

The “Innovate with BHASHINI” segment encouraged participants to share ideas and explore how BHASHINI could help transform problems into prototypes and scalable solutions.

Why Language AI Matters

  • Breaks language barriers in accessing digital services.
  • Uses AI-powered multilingual technology to make digital technology more inclusive, accessible and community-oriented.
  • Connects Artificial Intelligence with linguistic inclusion.

    • India–Nepal Language Technology Cooperation

  • BHASHINI शिल्पी strengthens India–Nepal cooperation in Language AI.
  • Brings together developers, academia and innovators.
  • Promotes knowledge exchange, idea sharing and co-creation.
  • Aims to build a cross-border ecosystem for inclusive digital solutions.

    • Significance for Digital Public Infrastructure

    BHASHINI represents an important dimension of India's digital transformation: language accessibility.

    Digital infrastructure becomes more inclusive when citizens can interact with technology in languages they understand.

    Therefore, Language AI can contribute to:

  • Reducing linguistic barriers
  • Improving accessibility of digital services
  • Enabling multilingual interfaces
  • Supporting technology adoption across communities
  • Creating opportunities for local developers and innovators

    • BHASHINI is India's national platform for AI-powered multilingual digital inclusion.

    Why is BHASHINI शिल्पी Important?

    1. From technology demonstration to technology creation: The programme does not merely showcase what Language AI can do. It encourages participants to build solutions themselves.

    2. Focus on real-world applications: Participants explore actual problem statements and use cases.

    3. Developer-centric approach: The programme provides developers and innovators with exposure to APIs and developer resources.

    4. Encourages scalability: The objective is not restricted to prototypes; participants are encouraged to think about scalable solutions.

    5. Promotes multilingual inclusion: Language technology can help make digital services accessible across linguistic communities.

    6. Strengthens India–Nepal cooperation: The programme creates a platform for technological collaboration between the two countries.

    BHASHINI uses Language AI to overcome linguistic barriers and make digital technology more inclusive. Its collaboration with Nepal can help build a stronger cross-border ecosystem for multilingual AI innovation.
